subject: Capacity heatmap & precommit check for Sentinel (late-stage)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@sentinelai.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.s@sentinelai.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity heatmap & precommit check for Sentinel (late-stage)

Team / Alex —

We are entering the final commercial review for Sentinel. They want a short runway guarantee for the POC and the first production ramp window (targeting mid-Jan start). Before we commit any reserved capacity, need a quick internal availability check and a proposed soft-hold that we can convert to a reservation once the contract milestone hits (payment + SOC2 attestation).

Ask: can infra/ops confirm the following by EOD PDT Thursday?
- Heatmap showing available NVIDIA A100/A40 (80GB/40GB) and A100s with low-quant nodes across our US pools for the Jan–Mar 2027 window (per-zone breakdown) — see attachment 'sentinel_capacity_heatmap_q4.csv'.
- Recommended standby configuration (min GPUs, preferred instance classes, and fallback variants) to maintain 99th pct latency SLO of 300ms for the expected workload (documented in 'sizing_notes_Sentinel_v2.pdf').
- Proposed soft-hold duration and the conversion trigger checklist (what events convert soft-hold -> committed).

Alex / Maya, giving you visibility — this will determine whether we offer a 30d soft-reservation before the contract is finalized. If you can share anticipated ramp dates and any hard constraints (region, data residency), that helps.

Attachments: sentinel_capacity_heatmap_q4.csv (csv), sizing_notes_Sentinel_v2.pdf (pdf), pb-standby-term-sheet.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@sentinelai.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity heatmap & precommit check for Sentinel (late-stage)

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Alex —
> 
> We are entering the final commercial review for Sentinel...

Quick summary from infra side after a preliminary sweep:
- Short answer: we have headroom across two US regions that meet the target classes but the exact mix is tight in Week 2–4 of Jan due to other scheduled ramps. See attached heatmap for per-pool counts.
- Preferred configuration (recommended): 6x A100 80GB (for baseline POC), 8x A40 48GB (standby/burst), with automatic fallback to a quantized A100-40GB variant for cost-sensitive paths. This keeps steady token throughput for the POC while preserving a low-latency path.
- Thermal/maintenance caveat: one of our AZs has a node maintenance window Jan 8–10 which would reduce effective capacity ~12% for that period. We can engineer around it by routing traffic to the secondary region for those 72 hours.

Soft-hold proposal:
- Ops can place a 72-hour soft-hold on identified pools now to give commercial time to finalize terms. If we get signed MSA + first milestone payment within 10 business days, we escalate soft-hold to a 30-day reservation (standard reservation workflow).
- Conversion triggers: executed contract + PO, SOC2 evidence (if requested), and a firm onboarding date.

I'll attach the CSV with node-level counts and a short runbook for routing and cache prewarm. Ben / Grace — can you confirm the hold mechanics and the UI flow required to turn the soft-hold into a reservation?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity heatmap & precommit check for Sentinel (late-stage)

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 11:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary from infra side after a preliminary sweep:

Adding ops confirmation and next steps:
- We can enact a 72-hour soft-hold effective immediately on the tagged pools Karthik listed. This will stop new allocations from picking those nodes and surface the reservation option in the console for the Sales/Finance teams.
- If Sales requests escalation to a reserved commitment, we require a signed DocuSign (link below) and the PO. Ops will run a quick smoke test and prewarm KV caches the night before the onboarding date.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sentinel-deposit-2026 (internal-prep link)
Conversion checklist (ops):
- Payment confirmed by Finance
- SLA tier and SLO documented in the MSA
- SOC2/attestation uploaded to the security portal
- Onboarding date confirmed in our runbook (we prewarm 24h before go-live)

Ben Carter
Director, Dedicated Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the heatmap. We appreciate the proposed fallback and the 72-hour soft-hold.

Sentinel's procurement has greenlit a soft-reservation while legal finishes the MSA redlines. We will:
- Approve the 72-hour soft-hold now and aim to send the signed DocuSign within 7 business days.
- Confirmed constraints: we need all capacity to be in US-West or US-East (no EU), and initial onboarding date target is 2027-01-17 (subject to final calendar confirmation).

Please proceed with the soft-hold; Maya and I will update you as we clear the PO. If Ops needs a contact for ramp day, that's me (alex.chen@sentinelai.com).

Regards,
Alex Chen
